title: GTA 6 vs GTA 5 on PS5: 30 FPS vs 60

short_title_options: GTA 6 vs GTA 5 on PS5: 30 FPS vs 60 #GTA6 #Shorts
GTA 6 is 30 FPS even on PS5 Pro. GTA 5 hits 60 #GTA6 #Shorts
GTA 6 runs at half the FPS of GTA 5 on PS5 #GTA6 #Shorts
short_description:
GTA 5's PS5 version (Expanded & Enhanced, 2022) has a Performance mode that targets 60 FPS. GTA 6 runs at 30 FPS, even on PS5 Pro: Rockstar told Kotaku the Pro's CPU isn't powerful enough for the game's simulation, and 40 FPS is ruled out too. The Pro gets ray-traced shadows and a sharper picture instead. Is 30 enough for you?

Sources: PC Gamer, Wccftech, Insider Gaming, Beebom (GTA 6); GameSpot, Wccftech, Game Informer (GTA 5 on PS5).
